# Hannune

> A Seoul-based AI studio building production Graph RAG systems and
AI agents for enterprise teams. Founded 2021. 8+ years of production
AI experience across Netflix, Sony, and LG Energy Solution. 2 AI
optimization patents registered in South Korea.

## What we do

Hannune offers three categories of services:

1. **Graph RAG Consulting** — Productized engagements with fixed
   scope, fixed price, and fixed timeline. Three packages: Starter
   PoC ($8,999, 3 weeks), Standard Production ($38,999, 6 weeks),
   Enterprise Full Agent (custom pricing, 12+ weeks). Plus Ops
   Retainer (from $3,499/month) for ongoing support.

2. **Entity Resolution API** — A SaaS subscription product launching
   Q3 2026. Public tier pricing ($0/$19/$99/$499 per month). Built
   on Splink with LLM disambiguation. Hosted at app.hannune.ai.

3. **2asy.ai** — Graph RAG-powered analytics platform. A separate
   product hosted at 2asy.ai.

## Recent work

- LG Energy Solution: LangGraph-based multi-agent pipeline for
  global talent data acquisition, integrating Crawl4AI and EXAONE.
- Gahyun Tax Accounting: Korean-language tax search system with
  Graph RAG over tax code, precedents, and case files.
- Microsoft Activision CMA Final Report: AI-powered legal and tax
  document search.
- Scenera (TinM AI): Enterprise AI systems for multiple sectors.

## Technical stack

LangGraph, Neo4j, vLLM, FastAPI, Crawl4AI, EXAONE, ElasticSearch,
LiteLLM, Docker. Korean-language NLP and bilingual (Korean/English)
document processing as core specialties.
